title: The Recluse's Final Tow
logline: An aging prospector's contract to tow her decommissioned habitat to an outer-system retirement orbit is contested when belt miners discover its massive radiator is the only thing preventing a nearby frozen slag baffle from melting.

roles.description: Former belt surveyor; sharp, proud, determined to spend her remaining years in the quiet aphelion orbit she paid for.
Representative for local ore dredgers; exhausted, practical, terrified that melting slag will crush the refinery approach.
Independent heavy tow captain; stubborn, legally bonded, refusing to cancel a contract without compensation.
Independent asteroid miners operating in the unstable slag channel.
A decommissioned orbital radiator habitat casting a massive thermal freeze-shadow across the belt.
The narrow shipping corridor flanked by volatile ice-cemented slag boulders.

public_situation: Tug crews arrive at {role:radiator_hulk} to execute a paid towing contract while {role:dredgers_union} blocks the flight path with drilling barges.
private_truth: The habitat's oversized thermal fin is the only heat sink preventing the frozen debris in {role:refinery_approach} from melting into an impassable boulder field.

beats.public_change: Tow cables latch onto {role:radiator_hulk} as ambient temperature sensors in the slag channel begin to climb.

missions.reason: She hires an outside pilot to scan the thermal boundary of the slag field and prove the habitat's shadow is keeping the boulders frozen.
missions.private_fact: The union knew the habitat cooled the rocks for ten years and never offered the recluse a credit for maintaining it.

beats.public_change: Slag boulders shed vapor trails as the tow tug warms its main thrusters, threatening an immediate debris breach.

missions.reason: Deliver silicate ballast to reinforce the habitat's secondary reaction mounts so the tow can commence before the miners sabotage the coupling.
missions.private_fact: She spent forty years living without company and would rather drift into deep space with failing life support than die on a station dock.

beats.public_change: Union mining barges surround the tow assembly as the tug contractor prepares to fire breakaway charges.

missions.reason: Recover an emergency coolant regulator pod from a cached drilling buoy to give both parties a technical alternative.
missions.private_fact: The tug contractor will forfeit his vessel's licensing bond if he fails to execute the departure on schedule.

player_choice.prompt: The tow lines are taut and the slag field is beginning to drift. The pilot must choose how to resolve the competing claims.

options.label: Sever the union interference and escort the recluse's habitat into her quiet aphelion retirement orbit
Install the coolant regulator to anchor a permanent automated heat sink, compensating the recluse while freeing her to leave
Disable the tow coupling to preserve the frozen shipping lane, trapping the recluse in the belt

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot escorts the tow vessel out of the system.
resolutions.summary: {role:solitary_recluse} reaches her quiet retirement orbit. The slag baffle melts behind her, shutting down {role:refinery_approach} for weeks.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot cleared the way for an old surveyor's final tow, even as the melting slag channel collapsed behind her.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a compromise using the auxiliary coolant pod.
resolutions.summary: An automated cooling rig stabilizes the slag field. {role:solitary_recluse} departs on schedule, and {role:dredgers_union} preserves its ore lane.

resolutions.reached_by: The tow proceeds without stabilization, or the pilot never intervenes.
resolutions.summary: {role:radiator_hulk} is dragged away without thermal shielding. The slag field melts and shatters, closing {role:refinery_approach} and crippling local mining.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot severs the tow coupling to protect the shipping lane.
resolutions.summary: The tow is cancelled and {role:radiator_hulk} remains locked in place. The shipping route stays open, but {role:solitary_recluse} loses her life savings.

loose_threads.detail: The thermal fin on {role:radiator_hulk} carries unlogged heat-pump junctions stamped by a defunct corporate navy yard.
A forfeiture rider on the recluse's towing bond transfers fifty thousand credits to an unlisted shell syndicate if delayed.
Survey manifests for the slag baffle show annual safety stamps signed by an inspector who retired two cycles earlier.

radio_hooks: Belt dredgers dispute departure schedule of decommissioned radiator habitat.
Thermal scans indicate anomalous ice-melting along primary asteroid transit channels.
Towing authority issues advisory regarding unescorted heavy-mass orbital maneuvers.

voice_direction.solitary_recluse: Dry, deliberate, and weary. Speaks in complete, unhurried sentences and treats every request for delay as an insult to her contract.
voice_direction.miners_delegate: Harried, breathless, and urgent. Uses practical mining idioms and repeatedly checks channel obstruction telemetry.
voice_direction.tug_contractor: Blunt, litigious, and inflexible. Cites towing charter clauses by paragraph and refuses any course that risks his operating bond.
